text: dsh-gemini-oauth-bridge 是 DSH Web 客户端的模型接入插件，通过 Google OAuth 将 Gemini 订阅模型包装为 OpenAI 兼容 provider。它增加 Gemini OAuth 设置页，登录后获取模型并同步 provider。主要功能包括模型发现、chat completions 接口、OpenAI 与 Gemini 对话和工具调用格式转换，以及流式响应。适合希望在 DSH 中使用 Google AI 订阅模型的用户；需授权 Google 账号，插件会自动配置 provider。

dsh-gemini-oauth-bridge connects Gemini subscription models to DSH web as an OpenAI-compatible provider via Google OAuth. It adds a settings page, fetches and syncs models, translates chat and tool calls, and supports streaming. Users authorize a Google account; provider setup is automatic.

dsh-gemini-oauth-bridge 的功能「Google OAuth 登录」：通过浏览器授权 Google 账号并接收本机回调，完成 Code Assist 注册并拉取模型目录。在设置页点击登录即可启动授权流程。
dsh-gemini-oauth-bridge 的功能「模型对话桥接」：将 OpenAI chat.completions 请求转换为 Gemini 请求并转发，再把响应转回兼容格式。DSH 调用聊天端点时自动处理。
dsh-gemini-oauth-bridge 的功能「模型列表同步」：登录或手动刷新时读取上游可用模型，并更新 DSH 的 Gemini provider 配置。用户可在设置页刷新模型目录。
dsh-gemini-oauth-bridge 的功能「工具调用转换」：将 OpenAI function tools、调用和结果映射为 Gemini 格式。发送带工具的聊天请求时自动转换。
dsh-gemini-oauth-bridge 使用 Google OAuth 和 Code Assist 接口获取模型并处理生成请求；对话请求会发送至 Google 的 Code Assist 服务。
dsh-gemini-oauth-bridge 将 OAuth token 和桥接状态保存在 ~/.dsh/gemini-oauth-bridge.json；DSH_HOME 可指定 settings.yaml 所在目录。

dsh-gemini-oauth-bridge README · dsh-gemini-oauth-bridge：English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

Bridges a **Google AI subscription** (AI Pro / AI Ultra, via the Antigravity / Code Assist OAuth surface) into an **OpenAI-compatible endpoint** that DeepSeek Harness (DSH) can use directly as a model provider.

dsh-gemini-oauth-bridge README · dsh-gemini-oauth-bridge：> **Important boundary**: Google AI subscription developer quotas only cover the AI Studio web UI and OAuth login inside official CLI tools (Gemini CLI / Antigravity); **API-key usage is billed separately**. This plugin speaks the same OAuth surface as the official client, so it consumes subscription quota rather than API credit — but that also means it is not a Google-sanctioned third-party integration. Account risk / breakage is possible; evaluate for yourself.

dsh-gemini-oauth-bridge README · Features：- **Login and go**: one-click Google OAuth from Settings → Gemini OAuth (authorization code + loopback callback), with automatic `loadCodeAssist` registration / `onboardUser` onboarding and upstream model discovery.
- **OpenAI-compatible endpoint**: `/gemini-oauth-bridge/v1/chat/completions` (streaming SSE + non-streaming) and `/v1/models` (so DSH can discover models).
- **Full protocol translation**: system messages, multimodal (data-URL images), function calling (tool_calls ↔ functionCall/functionResponse), `reasoning_content` (thinking stream), usage stats, finish-reason mapping.
- **Gemini 3 thought-signature replay**: the server remembers upstream `thoughtSignature` values by tool-call id and re-attaches them to functionCall parts on the next turn — OpenAI format carries no signatures, and Gemini 3 multi-turn tool calls fail without replay.
- **Subscription-friendly (anti-drift)**: dynamically tracks the latest shipping Antigravity client version for the User-Agent (stale versions are rejected for newer models); requests carry `requestType: "agent"`, a stable derived `sessionId`, and `agent-<uuid>` request IDs; keep-alive connections w

dsh-gemini-oauth-bridge README · Usage：1. Click **登录 Google 账号** (Log in with Google) and finish the flow in your browser. The plugin temporarily listens on `127.0.0.1:51121` for the loopback callback — this exact redirect URI is registered for the Antigravity client and the port cannot change. Port conflicts are reported explicitly.
2. After login the page shows the account, project ID, tier, and model list.
3. Register the bridge as a DSH provider in `~/.dsh/settings.yaml` (port matches your DSH web URL, default 3080):

dsh-gemini-oauth-bridge README · Usage：4. Pick the models in the model selector. **Step 3 is usually unnecessary**: logging in and refreshing the model list write this block automatically (the `baseURL` port follows the address you use to open the DSH UI). On DSH ≥ 0.2 the plugin edits the `llm-pi-ai` entry through the settings service — the same path the DSH Models page uses — so the refreshed model list is hot-applied to the running process and persisted into the active profile's `cordis.patch.yml`; no restart is needed. Older DSH versions get the legacy `~/.dsh/settings.yaml` write, which takes effect at the next restart. DSH refuses a provider profile that declares no credential, so the plugin also provisions the matching `GEMINI_OAUTH_API_KEY` entry in `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` (mode 0600) with the fixed placeholder `dsh-gemini-oauth-bridge` — an existing entry is never overwritten, and the bridge accepts any bearer token. To use your own key instead, set it through the Models page; to add local auth to the bridge itself, set `"apiKey": "some-string"` in `~/.dsh/gemini-oauth-bridge.json` — requests must then carry `Authorization: Bearer <value>`.
dsh-gemini-oauth-bridge README · Local state：`~/.dsh/gemini-oauth-bridge.json` (mode 0600, contains OAuth tokens — treat as a secret):

dsh-gemini-oauth-bridge README · Local state：| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `tokens` | access/refresh tokens and expiry |
| `email` / `project` / `tier` | login account and registration result |
| `models` | upstream model cache (refreshable from the UI) |
| `modelCaps` | per-model `contextLength` / `maxCompletionTokens` read from the upstream catalog |
| `modelsUnavailable` | ids the upstream catalog marks `disabled`, with the upstream explanation shown when such a model is requested |
| `trustedHosts` | extra `host:port` authorities the browser-trust fence accepts (for non-loopback deployments); loopback is always accepted |
| `signatures` | thoughtSignature replay cache (by tool-call id, cap 800) |
| `apiKey` | optional local auth for the bridge endpoint |
| `apiConfig` | optional upstream overrides (`generateBase` / `loadBase` / `onboardBase`); defaults match CLIProxyAPI: generation via daily, registration via prod |
dsh-gemini-oauth-bridge README · Design notes (anti-drift)：Protocol details follow the public implementation in [CLIProxyAPI](https://github.com/router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI) (Apache-2.0):

dsh-gemini-oauth-bridge README · Design notes (anti-drift)：- **Live version tracking**: the latest Antigravity version is fetched from the official updater hub (UA `electron-builder`, like the real updater), semver-validated, and cached for 6 hours — refreshed on the first request that finds the cache stale, not on a timer; failures fall back to the cache, then to the `2.9.1` floor (Cloud Code rejects clients below 2.9.0 for newer models).
- **Per-surface User-Agents**: generate/stream/loadCodeAssist use `antigravity/hub/<version> darwin/arm64`; onboardUser appends ` google-api-nodejs-client/10.3.0`; OAuth token refresh uses `Go-http-client/2.0` — each surface matches the real client.
- **Envelope semantics**: `requestType: "agent"`, `requestId: "agent-<uuid>"`, `userAgent: "antigravity"`, `request.sessionId` derived deterministically from the conversation's first message (one session per conversation); `safetySettings` stripped; `generationConfig.maxOutputTokens` removed for gemini-3 models.
- **Connection fingerprint**: no `Connection: close`; keep-alive reuse.
- **Backoff**: on 429, reads the `Retry-After` header or in-body `retryDelay`, enters a per-model cooldown (capped at 30

dsh-gemini-oauth-bridge README · Security：- OAuth tokens live in `~/.dsh/gemini-oauth-bridge.json` (mode 0600) and are never returned by any endpoint; `/api/status` exposes only account metadata (email, project, tier) and the model list.
- DSH applies a Host/Origin fence to its own `/api/*` routes, but a plugin `webServer.register({kind: 'prefix'})` route is dispatched before that fence, so the bridge enforces the same rules itself: a request is refused with 403 when its `Host` is not an authority the bridge serves, when `Sec-Fetch-Site: cross-site`, when `Origin` is the opaque `null` a sandboxed frame sends, when `Origin` disagrees with `Host`, or when a request arrives with no `Host` at all from anything other than a loopback peer. This blocks DNS-rebinding reads of `/api/status` and `/v1/*`, quota-burning calls through `/v1/chat/completions`, and blind-CSRF of the mutating POSTs (`/api/login`, `/api/logout`, `/api/refresh-models`) — a cross-site `Content-Type: text/plain` POST needs no CORS preflight, so without the fence the browser would deliver it.
- `/v1/*` is unauthenticated by default because DSH calls it locally; set `"apiKey"` in the state file to require `Authorization:

dsh-gemini-oauth-bridge README · Limitations：- **Unofficial usage**: relies on the Antigravity client's public OAuth credentials and a non-public `v1internal` surface; Google may change or restrict it at any time. Intended for individual subscribers' own use.
- Single account (no rotation); `http(s)://` image URLs unsupported (data URLs only); the signature cache is persisted but LRU-evicts past 800 entries.
- The login callback occupies `127.0.0.1:51121`; logging in while the Antigravity desktop app is also logging in may conflict.
- Generation goes to the `daily-cloudcode-pa` channel (matching CLIProxyAPI's default); override via `apiConfig` if needed.
- **Some catalog models cannot generate.** Upstream advertises entries it will not serve for your account — the Gemini 4 Argon family appears only as `gemini-4-argon-disabled` with `disabled: true`, `tagTitle: "Unavailable"` and `tagDescription: "Gemini 4 Argon is currently available to Ultra and paid Pro plan subscribers."`, and every id variant returns `404 NOT_FOUND` even on a paid `g1-pro-tier` (Google AI Pro) account. Catalog membership is therefore not proof that a model can generate; the plugin hides `disabled` entries, but

node --check lib/index.js && node --check lib/protocol.js && node --check lib/client.js

dsh-gemini-oauth-bridge README · Language (0.3.0)：The Settings section is bilingual (English / Simplified Chinese), using DSH's
`geminiOauth` locale namespace and framework-injected `t` seat. Change Language in
Settings → General; every plugin API request sends the active `?lang=zh|en`.
The root summary page and OpenAI-compatible bridge also accept this parameter.
Bridge errors with locale descriptors use the resolved language; raw errors,
status codes, and response envelopes are preserved. A valid explicit language
wins over `locale.preference` in `$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml` (default home:
`~/.dsh`); absent or unreadable preferences fall back to Chinese. The OAuth
callback remembers the language of the login request, since Google's navigation
does not carry `lang`. Google/upstream text is preserved verbatim. This requires
DSH's `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-locale` service, included in the web profile.

把 **Google AI 订阅**（AI Pro / AI Ultra，走 Antigravity / Code Assist OAuth 授权端点）桥接成 **OpenAI 兼容接口**，供 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）直接当模型 provider 使用。

> **重要边界**：Google AI 订阅的开发者配额只覆盖 AI Studio 网页界面与官方 CLI 工具（Gemini CLI / Antigravity）的 OAuth 登录；**API 密钥调用单独计费**。本插件走的是官方客户端同款 OAuth 授权端点，因此消耗的是订阅配额而不是 API 余额——但这也意味着它不是 Google 面向第三方客户端的官方支持用法，存在账号风控/失效风险，请自行评估。

[](README.md)

dsh-gemini-oauth-bridge README · 功能：- **登录即用**：Settings → Gemini OAuth 页面一键发起 Google OAuth 授权（授权码 + 本机回环回调），自动完成 `loadCodeAssist` 注册 / `onboardUser` 开通，并拉取可用模型列表。
- **OpenAI 兼容端点**：`/gemini-oauth-bridge/v1/chat/completions`（流式 SSE + 非流式）与 `/v1/models`（供 DSH 做模型发现）。
- **完整协议翻译**：system 消息、多模态（data URL 图片）、function calling（tool_calls ↔ functionCall/functionResponse）、`reasoning_content`（思考流）、usage 统计、finish_reason 映射。
- **Gemini 3 thought signature 回放**：服务端按 tool_call id 记住上游下发的 thoughtSignature，下一轮请求自动附回 functionCall part——OpenAI 格式本身不携带签名，这是多轮工具调用不报错的必要机制。
- **订阅额度友好（防风控）**：动态追踪 Antigravity 官方最新客户端版本号用于 User-Agent（版本过旧会被拒绝新模型）；请求信封带 `requestType: "agent"`、稳定派生的 `sessionId`、`agent-<uuid>` 请求 ID；连接复用不发送 `Connection: close`。
- **429 冷却**：解析上游 Retry-After / retryDelay，按模型进入冷却窗口，冷却期内直接本地返回 429，不硬刷上游。
- **不做虚假宣传的模型列表**：上游模型目录里标记 `disabled: true` 的条目（例如 `gemini-4-argon-disabled`，`tagTitle: "Unavailable"`、`tagDescription: "Gemini 4 Argon is currently available to Ultra and paid Pro plan subscribers."`）不会被写进 DSH 的模型列表，避免选择器里出现"选了必然失败"的模型；请求此类模型时返回上游自己的说明并提示刷新模型列表，而不是含义不明的 `404 Requested entity was not found`。模型的上下文/输出上限改从上游的 `maxTokens` / `maxOutputTokens` 字段读取。
- **浏览器信任围栏**：插件的 prefix 路由先于

2. 登录成功后页面显示账号、项目 ID、tier、模型列表。
3. 在 `~/.dsh/settings.yaml` 里把桥接端点注册为 DSH provider（端口以你的 DSH 网页地址为准，默认 3080）：

```yaml
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    gemini-oauth:
      api: openai-completions

dsh-gemini-oauth-bridge README · 使用：4. 在模型选择器里选用。**第 3 步通常无需手动做**：登录和刷新模型列表时会自动写入这段配置（`baseURL` 端口取自你访问 DSH 页面的地址）。DSH ≥ 0.2 时插件通过 settings 服务（与官方 Models 页面相同的路径）更新 `llm-pi-ai` 条目——变更即时热生效并持久化到活跃 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`，无需重启；旧版本 DSH 走遗留的 `~/.dsh/settings.yaml` 写入，重启后生效。DSH 要求 provider 必须声明凭据引用，因此插件会同时在 `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`（mode 0600）里补上固定占位 key `dsh-gemini-oauth-bridge`（引用名 `GEMINI_OAUTH_API_KEY`）——已有条目不会被覆盖，桥接端接受任意 key。想用自己的 key，可在 Models 页面里改；如需给桥接本身加一层本机鉴权，可在 `~/.dsh/gemini-oauth-bridge.json` 里设置 `"apiKey": "任意字符串"`，之后请求需带 `Authorization: Bearer <该值>`。

| `tokens` | access/refresh token 与过期时间 |

| `models` | 上游模型列表缓存（UI 里可手动刷新） |

dsh-gemini-oauth-bridge README · 设计说明（反风控要点）：参考 [CLIProxyAPI](https://github.com/router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI)（Apache-2.0）的公开实现，协议细节以其抓包结论为准：

dsh-gemini-oauth-bridge README · 设计说明（反风控要点）：- **版本号动态追踪**：从 Antigravity 官方更新 hub 拉取最新版本（请求 UA 用 `electron-builder`，与真实更新器一致），校验数字 semver 后缓存 6 小时——不是定时任务，而是遇到缓存过期后的第一个请求触发刷新；失败时退回缓存值，再退回兜底 `2.9.1`（Cloud Code 拒绝低于 2.9.0 的客户端使用新模型）。
- **UA 分场景**：generate/stream/loadCodeAssist 用 `antigravity/hub/<版本> darwin/arm64`；onboardUser 追加 ` google-api-nodejs-client/10.3.0`；OAuth token 刷新用 `Go-http-client/2.0`——每个环节与真实客户端一致。
- **信封语义**：`requestType: "agent"`、`requestId: "agent-<uuid>"`、`userAgent: "antigravity"`、`request.sessionId` 由对话首条消息稳定哈希派生（同一会话不换 session）；删除 `safetySettings`；gemini-3 系剔除 `generationConfig.maxOutputTokens`。
- **连接指纹**：不发送 `Connection: close`，复用 keep-alive 连接。
- **限流退避**：429 时读取 `Retry-After` 头或响应内 `retryDelay`，进入按模型冷却（上限 30 分钟），冷却期内不发出上游请求。
- **订阅 tier 识别**：请求权益按 `paidTier.id` 解析（Google AI Pro → `g1-pro-tier`），`currentTier` 显示 free-tier 只是注册态，不影响实际配额与模型访问。
- **provider 自动配置**：登录成功和「刷新模型列表」时，自动写入 `llm-pi-ai.providers.gemini-oauth` 路由（含最新模型 ID 和 `GEMINI_OAUTH_API_KEY` 凭据引用）。DSH 提供设置服务时走官方 Models 页面同款路径——变更即时热生效并持久化到活跃 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`，只动 gemini-oauth 这一个路由，且由适配器自身的 schema 校验、失败自动回滚；设置服务不可用或写入失败时，才会回退写入遗留的 `~/.dsh/settings.yaml`（外科手术式合并，首次修改前自动备份为 `settings.yaml.b

dsh-gemini-oauth-bridge README · 安全说明：- OAuth token 存放在 `~/.dsh/gemini-oauth-bridge.json`（mode 0600），任何接口都不会返回 token；`/api/status` 只暴露账号元信息（email、project、tier）与模型列表。
- DSH 对自身的 `/api/*` 有 Host/Origin 围栏，但插件的 `webServer.register({kind: 'prefix'})` 路由先于该围栏被派发，因此插件自行实现同样规则：`Host` 不是本插件服务的地址、`Sec-Fetch-Site: cross-site`、`Origin` 为不透明的 `null`、`Origin` 与 `Host` 不一致，或完全不带 `Host` 且对端不是回环地址时，一律返回 403。这样可阻断通过 DNS rebinding 读取 `/api/status` 与 `/v1/*`、借 `/v1/chat/completions` 消耗订阅配额，以及对有副作用 POST（`/api/login`、`/api/logout`、`/api/refresh-models`）的盲 CSRF——跨站 `Content-Type: text/plain` 的 POST 无需 CORS 预检，没有围栏时浏览器会照常发出。
- `/v1/*` 默认不鉴权（DSH 需要在本机直接调用）；在 state 文件中设 `"apiKey"` 可要求 `Authorization: Bearer <value>`，设 `"trustedHosts": ["host:port"]` 可服务非回环地址上的 DSH。

dsh-gemini-oauth-bridge README · 局限：- **非官方用法**：依赖 Antigravity 客户端的公开 OAuth client 凭据与非公开 `v1internal` 接口，Google 可能随时变更或限制；仅供个人订阅者自用。
- 单账号（不做多账号轮询）；`http(s)://` 图片 URL 不支持（仅 data URL 内联）；会话重启后 thoughtSignature 缓存仍在（持久化），但超过 800 条会 LRU 淘汰。
- 登录回调固定占用 `127.0.0.1:51121`；与 Antigravity 桌面客户端同时登录可能端口冲突。
- 上游为 `daily-cloudcode-pa` 通道（与 CLIProxyAPI 默认一致）；如需切换可通过 `apiConfig` 覆盖。
- **目录里有模型但无法生成**：上游会列出对本账号不提供服务的条目——Gemini 4 Argon 系列只以 `gemini-4-argon-disabled` 出现，带 `disabled: true`、`tagTitle: "Unavailable"`、`tagDescription: "Gemini 4 Argon is currently available to Ultra and paid Pro plan subscribers."`，且所有 ID 变体都返回 `404 NOT_FOUND`（实测即使在付费 `g1-pro-tier`（Google AI Pro）账号上也是如此）。因此在目录里 ≠ 可用；插件会隐藏 `disabled` 条目，但客户端无法把这类模型"打开"。

dsh-gemini-oauth-bridge README · 开发：零依赖、纯 ESM JavaScript（Node ≥ 22），`lib/*.js` 原样发布，无构建步骤。

```sh
node --check lib/index.js && node --check lib/protocol.js && node --check lib/client.js
node --test test/protocol.test.js test/host.smoke.test.js test/bridge.e2e.test.js
```

测试覆盖：协议翻译单测（OAuth URL/信封/流式分片/签名回放）、host 路由冒烟（mock cordis ctx + 真实 HTTP + 回环回调登录错误路径）、桥接端到端（mock 上游验证信封契约、SSE 翻译、429 冷却）。

dsh-gemini-oauth-bridge README · 语言（0.3.0）：设置界面支持简体中文和英文，使用 DSH 的 `geminiOauth` 语言命名空间和框架注入的
`t` 席位。在「设置 → 通用」切换语言；插件的每个 API 请求都会发送当前的
`?lang=zh|en`。根路径摘要页和 OpenAI 兼容桥接端点也接受此参数。
带语言描述符的桥接错误使用解析后的语言；原始错误、状态码和响应结构保持不变。有效的显式语言优先于
`$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml` 中的 `locale.preference`（默认目录为 `~/.dsh`）；
偏好缺失或无法读取时回退到中文。Google 跳转不携带 `lang`，因此 OAuth 回调页
沿用发起登录时的语言。Google / 上游文本保持原样。需要 web profile 已包含的
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-locale` 服务。

运行 `npm test` 检查协议、HTTP 集成和语言覆盖；无需构建步骤或运行时依赖。
